description: Source code for FPGA driver implementation specific to the EOS S3 platform in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for enabling/disabling clocks, power management, FPGA reset, load, and initialization.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_enable_clk
methods.description: Enables FPGA related clocks by setting specific clock gate registers.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_disable_clk
methods.description: Disables FPGA related clocks by clearing specific clock gate registers.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_get_status
methods.description: Returns the current FPGA status (active or inactive) based on PMU register.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_get_info
methods.description: Returns FPGA information string stored in device data.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_on
methods.description: Power on sequence for FPGA, including clock enable and programming enable.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_off
methods.description: Power off sequence for FPGA, disabling clocks and power modes.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_reset
methods.description: Resets the FPGA by turning off and then turning on.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_load
methods.description: Loads a bitstream into FPGA memory, disables programming after load.

methods.name: eos_s3_fpga_init
methods.description: Initializes FPGA device, sets FPGA info, and resets FPGA.
